title: Marvel Ultimate Alliance 3: The Black Order
subtitle: Four heroes face the Black Order
summary: Marvel Ultimate Alliance 3: The Black Order is Team Ninja's action role-playing game, released for Nintendo Switch on 19 July 2019.
body: Marvel Ultimate Alliance 3: The Black Order is Team Ninja's action role-playing game, released for Nintendo Switch on 19 July 2019. A team of Marvel heroes attempts to stop Thanos and the Black Order from gathering the Infinity Stones. The player selects four characters and fights through locations drawn from the wider Marvel universe. Local and online cooperation allow other people to take their places in the squad, turning the campaign into a shared sequence of battles, encounters and changing combinations of superpowers.

Each hero has ordinary attacks, defensive actions and special abilities. Synergy attacks combine compatible powers, while coordinated Extreme attacks let the whole team contribute to a larger burst. The choice of companions therefore changes what can happen when abilities meet, as well as which characters appear on screen. Switching heroes offers another response to an enemy or boss. Team combinations also provide bonuses, giving a familiar association from the comics a practical effect within the party's performance.

Characters gain levels through combat, while ISO-8 crystals and a shared upgrade system provide further ways to develop the team. Optional Infinity Rift challenges introduce conditions that test different uses of its abilities and unlock additional rewards. The story establishes its own version of the Marvel setting, drawing characters together without requiring the previous games' plot. Its strongest connection to the series is the pleasure of assembling a personal lineup and seeing distinctive powers become useful parts of one cooperative assault.
